title: Bug:sonic-vpp nightly build failed
author: yue-fred-gao
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

sonic-vpp nightly build failed. This happens with option SONIC_DPKG_CACHE_METHOD=wcache
2025-05-29T09:12:10.1025946Z make: *** No rule to make target 'libvppinfra_2506-0.1+b1sonic1_amd64.deb_SRC_PATH/Makefile', needed by 'target/debs/bookworm/libvppinfra_2506-0.1+b1sonic1_amd64.deb.dep'.  Stop.
2025-05-29T09:12:10.1026338Z make: *** Waiting for unfinished jobs....
2025-05-29T09:12:11.9767004Z make[1]: *** [Makefile.work:612: target/sonic-vpp.img.gz] Error 2

### Steps to Reproduce

Repeat with the same make command: make USERNAME=admin SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS=py2,py3,web,git,docker SONIC_DPKG_CACHE_METHOD=wcache SONIC_DPKG_CACHE_SOURCE=/nfs/dpkg_cache/vpp INSTALL_DEBUG_TOOLS=y target/sonic-vpp.img.gz

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Build should not fail

#### Why I did it
Fixes #22773 that causes sonic-vpp nightly test failure
##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
The issue is due to incorrect variable reference in vpp.dep, which seems only triggered with SONIC_DPKG_CACHE_METHOD option.
#### How to verify it
Run make with the same options as nightly build.

make USERNAME=admin SONIC_BUILD_JOBS=4 SONIC_VERSION_CONTROL_COMPONENTS=py2,py3,web,git,docker SONIC_DPKG_CACHE_METHOD=wcache SONIC_DPKG_CACHE_SOURCE=/nfs/dpkg_cache/vpp INSTALL_DEBUG_TOOLS=y target/sonic-vpp.img.gz
